name: Breast cancer
description: Malignant neoplasm arising from breast epithelium; molecular subtypes are defined largely by hormone-receptor and HER2 status.

name: Non-small cell lung cancer
description: Non-small cell lung carcinoma, including adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma; many targeted therapies are selected by driver alterations.

name: Colorectal cancer
description: Adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum; RAS/BRAF status and mismatch-repair status guide therapy selection.

name: Prostate cancer
description: Adenocarcinoma of the prostate gland; androgen-receptor signalling and DNA-repair alterations are key molecular features.
